old_problem: Routed and isolated VLAN topologies were conflated even though the protected Criteria explicitly requires bidirectional denial.
disposition_reason: The Master Criteria is authoritative: this case validates an intentionally isolated topology where different VLAN IDs must not communicate. Exact tags/endpoints/switch/ACL are runtime bindings. A routed/permit topology is outside this case's prerequisite and cannot reverse the expected result or count as PASS.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row73 all18 XLSX cells and history2684.
Preserved both ping directions and both file-transfer denial directions.
Rejected invented interfaces/addresses and one-direction coverage; no VLAN/network change occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized different-VLAN bidirectional ping and file-transfer isolation validation
test_case.purpose: Prove an approved isolated VLAN pair blocks bidirectional ICMP and transfer of a harmless test artifact when no authorized inter-VLAN path exists.
required_package: Identity-locked DUT/client parent/bond/netdev and distinct VLAN IDs
Switch trunk/access configuration, VRF/router/ACL/firewall proof of intended deny policy
Conflict-free endpoint IP/prefix/route mapping and independent management path
Approved bounded ping parameters and harmless unique test artifact/protocol
Negative-test timeout, packet/counter evidence, rollback and invalid-run policy
test_case.test_command: Verify endpoints are on the two approved distinct tags and capture switch/router/ACL/firewall plus routes. With independent management, run bounded ping DUT-to-client and client-to-DUT, then attempt transfer of a unique non-sensitive artifact in each direction using the approved protocol. Capture endpoints and enforcement counters, prove no artifact arrived, and remove only test-created VLAN/address/artifact state.
test_case.expected_result: Both ping directions time out or are explicitly denied as specified, neither transfer completes nor creates the artifact at the destination, and the deny enforcement/path matches the approved isolation policy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative deny-policy topology and all four negative directions with bounded evidence. Different VLAN IDs alone are insufficient, and a routed/permit environment cannot be judged by this case.
safety_gate: Do not invent VLAN IDs, interfaces, IPs, routes or firewall rules.
Keep management/OOB outside the tested isolation path.
Use harmless uniquely named artifacts and bounded timeouts; verify absence without broad deletion.
Abort on unintended reachability or management impact; no automatic policy change or retry.
expected_evidence: Endpoint/VLAN/switch/VRF/ACL/firewall topology and intended deny authority
Both transfer-denial records and destination absence checks
test_case.recovery: If unexpected cross-VLAN traffic succeeds, stop further transfers, preserve packets/routes/ACL counters and received test artifact, remove only test-created state/artifacts after evidence capture, restore the approved baseline configuration, and escalate the isolation breach to the network/security owner.
